description: Anonymized, coarse-grained replay of the real macOS install session referenced by plans/260827-real-user-install-review/task_plan.md §2.2/§2.3 (37 steps, 36 tool calls, ~15m40s, ~2m31s waiting on the user). No real usernames, hostnames, project paths, session content, or company identifiers appear here; placeholders such as <USER_HOME> stand in for anything that was.

sourceFacts.finalStateBeforeThisFix: build completed, plugin not installed, Split Pane not verified, no declared terminal state

steps.observation: User asked the agent to install DSH Workbench and enable Split Pane in the current Web profile.
Agent read the README default path: clone the repository, obtain a 40-character commit hash from the user, perform a detached checkout, then run pnpm install and build.

Agent asked the user to paste the 40-character pinned commit hash to authorize source verification; the user needed a clarifying exchange before complying (this and one later question account for most of the ~2m31s user wait).
Agent cloned the repository with --no-checkout into an isolated build directory under <USER_HOME>, then performed a detached checkout at the pinned commit.
Agent ran pnpm install --frozen-lockfile across the workspace.
Agent ran the full build and the 187-test release-check suite as part of the same source-verification flow; all tests passed.
Agent hit an avoidable execution error while resolving the pinned Harness fork's build output path (one of 5 avoidable errors logged across the session); recovered after a retry.
Agent built local TGZ artifacts for the Workbench packages.
Agent inspected the user's stock Harness and found it does not implement Session Presentation protocol 2, so Split Pane cannot activate regardless of whether the plugin installs.
Agent attempted to install the built TGZ into <USER_HOME>/.dsh/profiles/web and found the sandbox could not write to that path.
Instead of producing one deterministic command, the agent asked the user whether to expand sandbox filesystem permissions — a path this contract's evaluateEnvironment explicitly forbids.
Agent's final message described the TGZ build as complete and gave one manual command, but never declared installed, manual-action-required, incompatible, or failed.
Session ended with the plugin not installed and Split Pane unverified in the user's profile; this ambiguity is exactly what the four-terminal-state contract in scripts/install/result.mjs closes.
